acceptance_evidence.AC1_sidebar_and_four_tabs: groups.researchAndEvolution includes /management/meetings with the four tabs (upcoming, history, proposals, rules/budget) reading only /bff/management/meetings* routes
acceptance_evidence.AC2_meeting_detail_page: MeetingDetailPage renders header, MT-4 attribution record above rounds, agenda, shared case-file items, pre-read interpretations, Round 1 and Round 2 with anonymised labels and operator-only reveal, chair synthesis, non-binding tally, dissent memo, proposals with live downstream links, per-participant memory writeback IDs, and usage, while stripping and never rendering private memory text
acceptance_evidence.AC3_persona_tab_and_consult_rules: PersonaDetail mounts the meetings tab (/management/personas/:id?tab=meetings) via PersonaMeetingsPanel; ConsultRulesPage separates M1 gate panels from deliberative meetings and links to /management/meetings?tab=rules
acceptance_evidence.AC4_human_inbox_items: humanInbox.ts and HumanInboxPage support meeting_review (meetings ending in REVIEW), meeting_refusal (due meetings refused for insufficient_participants), and meeting_proposal (proposals waiting for operator) with links to meeting detail and budget tab
acceptance_evidence.AC5_convene_write_gated_and_idempotent: MeetingsCenterPage and conveneMeeting enforce write-gating via useAgoraWriteAccess and liveWriteGated and send an Idempotency-Key header
acceptance_evidence.AC6_route_manifest_and_crawl_rules: /management/meetings and /management/meetings/mtg_001 are registered in managementRouteManifest.ts and scripts/lib/management-routes.mjs (with ENTITY_LIST_ENDPOINTS.meetings = '/bff/management/meetings'); empty and unavailable states are explicit and 404 renders an honest not-found
acceptance_evidence.AC7_component_and_existing_tests: All new and existing Vitest suites and TypeScript typechecks pass
acceptance_evidence.AC8_evidence_recorded_no_credentials: Commands and results recorded below; no credentials or secrets included
